parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
const o = d.output;

const lines = [
  '# ' + o.title,
  o.executiveSummary,
  '',
  '## Tendances majeures',
  ...o.majorTrends.map(x => '- ' + x.title + ' — ' + x.synthesis),
  '',
  '## Signaux faibles',
  ...o.weakSignals.map(x => '- ' + x.title + ' — ' + x.synthesis),
  '',
  '## Évolutions réglementaires',
  ...o.regulatoryDevelopments.map(x => '- ' + x.title + ' — ' + x.impact),
  '',
  '## Opportunités commerciales',
  ...o.commercialOpportunities.map(x => '- ' + x.title + ' — ' + x.recommendedAction),
  '',
  '## Risques et points de veille',
  ...o.risksAndWatchpoints.map(x => '- ' + x.title + ' — ' + x.explanation),
  '',
  '## Actions prioritaires',
  ...o.priorityActions.map(x => '- ' + x.title + ' — ' + x.action)
];

const sourceRefs = (d.hydratedCorpus || []).map(item => ({
  entityType: item.kind,
  entityId: item.id,
  label: item.title,
  sourceName: item.provenance
}));

const contextSnapshot = {
  schemaVersion: 2,
  triggerMode: 'manual_custom',
  intention: d.input.intention,
  requestedAt: d.input.requestedAt,
  refs: d.input.refs,
  stats: d.input.stats
};

const callback = {
  n8nExecutionId: typeof $execution !== 'undefined' ? $execution.id : 'test-exec-id',
  n8nWorkflowId: typeof $workflow !== 'undefined' ? $workflow.id : 'intel-021-monthly-watch-analysis',
  runId: d.runId,
  phase: 1,
  resultType: 'strategic_watch_analysis',
  status: 'succeeded',
  contentJson: o,
  contentText: lines.join('\n'),
  title: o.title,
  modelProvider: 'anthropic',
  modelUsed: d.model,
  tokensInput: d.llmUsage.input_tokens || null,
  tokensOutput: d.llmUsage.output_tokens || null,
  contextSnapshot,
  sourceRefs,
  qaFlags: d.qaFlags
};

return [{ json: { callbackUrl: d.callbackUrl, rawBody: JSON.stringify(callback) } }];
